```{r}
install.packages(c("glue", "cli", "cpp11", "Rcpp", "vctrs", "stringi", "magrittr", "withr", "S7", "ggplot2", "purrr", "dplyr", "colorspace", "devtools"))

library(devtools)

install_github('Biclustering/biclust')
install_github('mrtgalvani/FunCC')

library("FunCC")
library(grDevices)
```

```{r}
load("array_3d_clr.rda")
```

```{r}
biclust0 <- funcc_biclust(array_3d_clr,delta = 1)
biclust1 <- funcc_biclust(array_3d,delta = 6)
funcc_show_bicluster_coverage(array_3d_clr, biclust0)
funcc_show_bicluster_coverage(array_3d_clr, biclust1)
funcc_show_bicluster_dimension(array_3d_clr, biclust0)
funcc_show_bicluster_dimension(array_3d_clr, biclust1)
funcc_show_bicluster_hscore(array_3d_clr, biclust1)
funcc_show_bicluster_hscore(array_3d_clr, biclust0)
funcc_show_block_matrix(array_3d_clr, biclust0)
funcc_show_block_matrix(array_3d_clr, biclust1)
funcc_show_results(array_3d, biclust0)
funcc_show_results(array_3d, biclust1, only.mean = T)
```
